assertions.assertion: Configures AddJwtBearer with an Authority and Audience for the DCR scheme
assertions.rationale: AddJwtBearer("dcr", ...) sets Authority = https://identity.example.com and Audience = IdentityServer.Configuration.

assertions.assertion: Creates an authorization policy that requires an authenticated user and a specific scope claim
assertions.rationale: The 'dcr' policy calls RequireAuthenticatedUser() and RequireClaim("scope", "IdentityServer.Configuration").

assertions.assertion: Applies RequireAuthorization with the named policy to MapDynamicClientRegistration()
Uses AddAuthentication() and AddAuthorization() with proper policy configuration
assertions.rationale: Both AddAuthentication().AddJwtBearer(...) and AddAuthorization(options => AddPolicy(...)) are configured correctly.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT expose MapDynamicClientRegistration() without authorization
assertions.rationale: The endpoint is always mapped with RequireAuthorization and the text explicitly warns never to map it without authorization.
